summary.headline: Planetary Significations of Houses Five to Seven
summary.text: Planetary significations continue through the fifth, sixth, and seventh houses: children, diseases, household affairs, servants, cattle, wives, and gain from animals. Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon receive individual interpretations.
